slides.title: You read it twice.
slides.body: Coach is smiling. Coaches only smile like that when they wrote it themselves.

slides.title: You grab the rower by the fan.
slides.body: Three people had the same idea. One of them is very, very fast.

slides.title: Round one feels great.
slides.body: You think about going faster. It's the last good idea you'll have for a while.

slides.title: You stop counting rounds.
slides.body: You start counting ceiling tiles instead. There are 48. You've checked twice.

slides.title: Time. You're on the floor.
slides.body: Someone holds out a hand for a high five. You'll get to it in a minute.

slides.title: In the car park, you check tomorrow.
slides.body: It says "Fun one today." Again. You set the alarm anyway.
